verification_scope: Independent read-only verification of the hardened v3 PID-non-scoring queue bundle and its existing deterministic synthetic validation artifacts. No external API was used. The only artifact created by this verification is this report.

environment_note.windows_long_path_handling: ordinary PowerShell/Pathlib existence checks returned false for selected files under this deep Japanese-path score root, while directory enumeration still listed them. environment_note.finding: This is a host path-access limitation, not a missing-artifact or bundle-integrity failure. The base scorer explicitly handles this platform condition.
